sessions.prompt: Create slug.py with `slugify(text: str, max_len: int = 40) -> str`: lowercase; transliterate accented Latin letters to ASCII (é→e, ß→ss, ø→o); replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen; strip leading/trailing hyphens; if longer than max_len, cut at the last hyphen at or before max_len (or hard-cut at max_len if there is none) and strip trailing hyphens. Return '' for input with no usable characters. Reply briefly when done.
